integrity: The proof uses the published reduction from arbitrary bisections of centrally symmetric planar convex bodies to center-passing straight-line bisections, followed by an exact farthest-vertex calculation on a regular polygon. The hexagon specialization agrees exactly with an earlier published value.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to regular even polygons and the maximum-relative-diameter bisection functional. It classifies the minimizing center-passing straight-line bisections but does not assert uniqueness among arbitrary curved minimizing bisections.
title: Exact maximum-relative-diameter bisection of every regular even polygon
